data.why: The repository bundles the exact PDB/mmCIF files the app's own 'Examples' pills name (1LMB, 5NKT, 8UTF, 1UBQ) plus a few more small structures (1TIM TIM barrel, 2HHB haemoglobin, 1BL8 membrane channel) under tests/data/, small and ready to hand to the app's file-drop uploader.

goals: Load a solved structure (a PDB/mmCIF file) and get a clean 2D topology diagram of its helices, strands and loops
Check the automatically assigned secondary structure, β-sheet order and symmetry against what is known about the protein
Highlight and annotate ligands, disulfides, membrane-spanning helices or bound DNA/RNA for a figure
Fine-tune the layout (swap, move, rename, recolour elements) until the figure reads cleanly for publication
Export the finished diagram as SVG/PNG/PDF (and the underlying data as JSON/CSV) for a paper or presentation

review.summary: The tree has the right shape for a figure-making tool and its specific labels and cited screens are accurate, but it leaves out several of the README's headline uses: DNA/RNA folds, conservation from an alignment, your own per-residue data, and draw-like/compare/diff. It also blames an empty 1LMB file on the test data when the repository's copy is fine and the fault was in staging. File it after re-staging 1LMB, adding those tasks and features, and tidying the agent-mechanics actions and the oversized f7.
